chunks: And he was asked: When does the prayer for him become obligatory?
He said: “When he understands prayer and is six years old.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the prayer, here referring to the funeral prayer
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: for him, meaning over the deceased child

ai.seo_question: When does salat al-janazah become obligatory for a child in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning when the funeral prayer is to be performed for a child. It states that this applies when the child has reached an age of understanding regarding prayer and is six years old.
